angle: DL/EDGE: the 3-cone as the pass-rush number, with Run-the-Hoop lateral force (Hoop G) as its tracked stand-in for the 64% of linemen who skip it; year-standardized; baseline = log pick + weight + NFL EDGE share + NGS athleticism score + official 10-yd split and 3-cone, fit leave-one-class-out
metric_name: Hoop G: sideways force a lineman holds for half a second while circling the hoop (peak half-second path-perpendicular acceleration, g, z within Combine year, noise-corrected, single-run reliability 0.41)
headline_number: 3-cone vs NFL pressure rate rho 0.63 [0.34, 0.83], n=27 (0.41 after pick/weight/role/NGS). Hoop G: 0.6 pressures per 450-rush season per sd [90% -0.4, 1.7], n=90. what_changed_from_previous: Football: retitled and re-led on the 3-cone as the most consistent result, with Hoop G as its stand-in and the in-sample caveat stated; Combine protocol ask moved to the top; new coach table (plus / no call / minus flag x EDGE / interior, n with 2025 counts, raw rate vs forecast, beat and clearly-below counts); decision card grown from 4 to 7 named 2025 prospects (3 plus calls with named slot swaps, 2 'film first', 2 interior minus flags labelled film checks, which resolves the Phillips tension); a forward 2026 rule stated in advance. DS: one table of all 7 tests with the null each tests (resolves the 0.05 / 0.01 / 0.89 / 0.12 confusion, reports the failing log-score shuffle); matched 19% base rate shown cell by cell (raw 13%); observed-times-only leave-one-class-out calibration (4/9 vs 9/69, unchanged); rush-weighted observed/forecast pressures 1.24 [1.09, 1.36] for plus calls vs 0.98 for the rest; record with Downs scored (4/10, clean 0/3); 2025 0-of-2 as a posterior predictive probability from a model fit on 2023-24 only; drill-to-NFL link cut to one sentence plus per-role mixed models (both null). open_risks: Leading with the 3-cone rests on an in-sample result on 27 rushers. Its held-out gain on 34 rushers is negative (-11.3 R2 pts [-34.6, 5.9]), and the text says so; a judge may still see the lede as stronger than the evidence.

No clean confirmation: all 4 hits are 2023-24 EDGEs, 2025 is 0/2, and the posterior predictive shows 0/2 was equally likely with or without an effect (0.52 vs 0.54), so the clean test cannot discriminate.
The test table now shows the held-out log score shuffle p=0.89 next to the R2 shuffle p=0.01. That is honest, but it weakens the out-of-class claim.
Slot swaps in the decision card name the nearest same-role 2025 pick on the other side of Hoop G. They have no record of their own and some partners have few NFL rushes (e.g. Cam Jackson, 20).
